component: Flash-Next batched one-token sparse QSA arm (oMLX #4070 'batched QSA decode/verify without per-row re-pooling or dense masked SDPA')
status: Implemented, default off (FlashNextPolicy.qsa_batch_decode_sparse = "off", floor 32768), unqualified, not selected. GPU: indexed arm +2.5..+3.5% at 32K (4/8 lanes ordinary, 4 lanes MTP+handoff), -3.6% at 16K, inert at 64K; tokens diverge from the masked arm by reduction-order rounding (layer outputs within 1 bf16 ulp, K/V identical); gather arm -4.0% at 4x32K. See qualification/runs/port-qsa-rowbanks-20261002/README.md for the applicability analysis and GPU evidence.

source_commits.df1d176b: perf(qwen4_exp): keep per-row QSA pooled banks across batched steps -- read, NOT ported: mlx2 already keeps batched pooled banks (MLX_QWEN4_QSA_POOLED_KEY_CACHE, pinned on by the Flash-Next profile, plus the ragged pooled tail MLX_QWEN4_QSA_POOLED_TAIL, default on) and never builds per-row singleton caches in the batched indexer
source_commits.797ae8f6: perf(qwen4_exp): attend batched decode/verify rows over their QSA selection -- mechanism ported for one-token batched steps only (verify windows >= 16K already take mlx2's indexed QSA kernel)

source_regions: language.py Attention._gathered_batch_paddings / _gathered_batch (+ _GATHERED_BATCH_DISABLED, _GATHERED_BATCH_MAX_QUERY): eligibility (B >= 2, one query row, a row past the crossover) and the arithmetic (gather each row's selected K/V, one bool-masked SDPA) -- behaviour only
qsa_fast.py batched_causal_block_selection: read; mlx2 keeps its own batched indexer selection (QSAIndexer.__call__), unchanged

modifications: No selection code ported: the arm consumes mlx2's existing QSASelection (same indexer, same pooled keys, same argpartition), so the selected key set is the masked arm's by construction (no tie-order difference as in #4070).

Two arithmetic choices behind one switch: 'gather' runs mlx2's existing _gather_qsa_attention (gather + bool-masked MLX SDPA, #4070's arithmetic); 'indexed' runs mlx2's indexed QSA kernel through decide_qsa_indexed_admission with a min_context_override (MLX_QWEN4_QSA_INDEXED=0 still refuses).
Scope: only B >= 2, L == 1 calls that no other sparse arm (NAX, indexed, gather) already took, at physical width >= qsa_batch_decode_sparse_min_context (default 32768). Verify windows unchanged.

Kill switch MLX_QWEN4_QSA_BATCH_DECODE_SPARSE=off (default); every candidate counted (attempts, engaged_<arm>, engaged_rows, fallback_<reason>) in qsa_batch_decode_sparse_status(), surfaced in FlashNextAdapter.diagnostics() only when used or selected.
